h2. Description

When a technician's time entry is moved to another line of the same work order, that line's *Labor* should list the people who worked on it, and only them. Nobody on the work order was deleted, so no *Deleted user* entry should appear.

For example,
* after *Esther Howard*'s time entry is moved from line 1 to line 2, line 2's *Labor* lists *Esther Howard* and a second entry, *Deleted user*
* production, after the same move, lists only real people on the receiving line

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open a work order that has two approved lines. Click the *Lines* tab. On *line 1*, click *Start* to clock in a technician (for example Esther Howard), wait a minute, click the clock button again, type a story and click *Clock Out*.
# Click the three-dots button at the top right of the tabs and click *Timesheets*.
# On the technician's row (Line "1 - …"), click the pencil button at the right. The *Edit Timesheet* window opens.
# In *Line*, pick line *2* and click *Save*.
# Click the *Lines* tab and reload the page. Read line 2's *Labor*.
#* *Actual Result:* line 2's *Labor* lists *Esther Howard* and also *Deleted user*.
#* *Expected Result:* line 2's *Labor* lists *Esther Howard*, and only real people. No *Deleted user* entry.

h2. Screenshots

!deleted-user-staging-vs-production.png|width=1000!

h2. Current behaviour

* The line that received the time entry shows an extra entry named *Deleted user*.
* No staff member on this work order was deleted. Staging refuses to delete a staff member who has logged time ("Staff is being used elsewhere").

h2. Expected behaviour

* The line that received the time entry lists the technician whose time was moved, as production does.
* No *Deleted user* entry appears for people who still exist.


h2. Environment

* *Staging:* [app.staging.shopview.com|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders], build {{v26.40.17-a5c4210}}, location *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, user Admin. Example work order: *S2-35973* (customer "ZZAUTOTEST Move Labor 28477"; find it with the search box at the top), 15 Oct 2026.
* *Production (works):* [app.shopview.com|https://app.shopview.com/workorders], build {{v26.40.18-163ddfa}}, location *Truck Hill 1*, work order *S1-3*. The time entry was moved from line 1 to line 2 on 12 Oct 2026; line 2 read on 15 Oct 2026 lists only *Technician 1* and *Service Advisor No Reports (Admin)*.

h2. Sources

* *Developer's regression list for this release (epic SV-10043, PR #3548), item High 2, received 8 Oct 2026, as quoted in the test case:* "Move a labor task from one line to another: the target line takes the technician."
* *Production behaviour (the version people use today):* the receiving line lists only real people (picture, right half).
